people.title: Team
people.description: Everyone who can sign in to your business, what they can do, and where.
people.loadError: We could not load your team.
people.readOnly: You can see the team, but only someone with permission to manage people can make changes.

add.title: Add a person
add.intro: They will sign in with this email and the password you set. There is no email invite yet, so share the password with them privately.
add.name: Full name
add.emailHint: Used to sign in. Each email can belong to one person only.
add.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with them in person or by a private message.
add.rolesHint: Roles chosen here apply at every location. You can limit them to certain locations afterwards from Manage.
add.rolesUnavailable: You can add roles after creating this person.
add.noRoleWarning: Without a role they can sign in but will not see anything yet.
add.done: {{name}} was added. Share their password with them privately.

email.invalid: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.

confirm.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

err.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err.noAccess: You do not have permission to do this.
err.notFound: This person no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
err.emailTaken: Someone already uses this email. Use a different one.
err.selfChange: You cannot do this to your own account. Ask another owner to help.
err.beyondYourRole: You can only give out roles that are within your own access.
err.beyondYourLocations: You can only give access to locations you can reach yourself.
err.invalid: Some details were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

empty.title: No one matches
empty.body: Try a different name, status or role.
empty.teamTitle: It is just you so far
empty.teamBody: Add the people who work with you so they can sign in with their own account.

detail.lockedUntil: Locked out after too many wrong passwords, until {{time}}. Setting a new password unlocks them.
detail.selfNote: This is your account. You cannot change your own access, password or status here; ask another owner if you need to.
detail.ownerNote: Owners have full control of the business, including the team.

access.title: Change access for {{name}}
access.intro: Pick what {{name}} can do. Changes apply on their next action, no sign-out needed.
access.beyond: Beyond your own access, so you cannot give this role.
access.pickLocations: Pick at least one location, or choose All locations.
access.ownerRemoval: Removing Owner takes away their full control of the business.
access.noRoleWarning: With no role they can still sign in but will not see anything.
access.rolesUnavailable: We could not load the list of roles.
access.partial: Some changes were saved and some were not. The current access is shown below.

password.title: Set a new password for {{name}}
password.intro: This signs {{name}} out on every device and clears any sign-in lock. Share the new password with them privately.
password.label: New password
password.done: New password set for {{name}}. They have been signed out everywhere.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: {{name}} will be signed out within a minute and cannot sign in until you reactivate them. Their sales, orders and history stay as they are.
suspend.ownerWarning: {{name}} is an owner. While suspended they cannot manage the business.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: {{name}} can sign in again with their existing password and keeps the access they had.

roleDesc.owner: Full control of the business, including billing, settings and the team.
roleDesc.location-manager: Runs day-to-day operations, menus, tables and reports.
roleDesc.checkout-associate: Takes payments, prints bills and handles their shift.
roleDesc.service-team: Seats guests and takes orders on the floor.
roleDesc.host: Manages bookings, the waiting list and seating.
roleDesc.kitchen-team: Sees and updates the kitchen order screen only.
roleDesc.accountant: Reviews costs, approves expenses and reads financial reports.
